ledger_holds_terminal_state_chk.name: ledger_holds_terminal_state_chk
ledger_holds_terminal_state_chk.value: ("samra_core"."ledger_holds"."state" = 'active' and "samra_core"."ledger_holds"."terminal_at" is null) or ("samra_core"."ledger_holds"."state" <> 'active' and "samra_core"."ledger_holds"."terminal_at" is not null)

ledger_journals_posted_at_state_chk.name: ledger_journals_posted_at_state_chk
ledger_journals_posted_at_state_chk.value: ("samra_core"."ledger_journals"."state" = 'draft' and "samra_core"."ledger_journals"."posted_at" is null) or ("samra_core"."ledger_journals"."state" in ('posted', 'reversed') and "samra_core"."ledger_journals"."posted_at" is not null)

reconciliation_exceptions_resolution_sta.name: reconciliation_exceptions_resolution_state_chk
reconciliation_exceptions_resolution_sta.value: ("samra_core"."reconciliation_exceptions"."state" in ('resolved', 'ignored') and "samra_core"."reconciliation_exceptions"."resolved_at" is not null) or ("samra_core"."reconciliation_exceptions"."state" in ('open', 'in_review') and "samra_core"."reconciliation_exceptions"."resolved_at" is null)
